Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.skin

Schnittstelle SkinProvider

public interface SkinProvider
A source of skin data that SkinService can consult.

The built-in provider talks to Mojang's session servers. Registering another one is how a network with its own skin database, a custom skin plugin or an offline-mode setup supplies skins without BetterNPCs knowing anything about it. Providers are tried in descending priority() order and the first non-empty answer wins, so a custom provider can shadow Mojang for some names and defer for the rest.

Implementations are called off the main thread and must never block it.

Seit:
1.0.0

      static final int MOJANG_PRIORITY

    • priority

      default int priority()
      Returns this provider's position in the lookup order.

    • supports

      boolean supports(SkinSource source)
      Returns whether this provider can even attempt the given source.

      Checked before fetch(SkinSource) so that a provider which only understands, say, player names is never asked about a unique id.

      Parameter:
      source - the source to resolve

    • fetch

      CompletableFuture<Optional<NpcSkin>> fetch(SkinSource source)
      Fetches the skin for a source.

      Called on a background thread. An empty result means "I do not know this one", and the next provider is tried; a failed future means the lookup broke, which is logged and also falls through to the next provider. Implementations must apply their own timeout — a provider that hangs would otherwise stall every skin request behind it.

      Parameter:
      source - the source to resolve, guaranteed to satisfy supports(SkinSource)
      Gibt zurück:
      a future completing with the skin, or with an empty value if this provider has none
